name: Cyberdramon
main_effect:
＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
[When Attacking] Trash 1 of your Option cards in the battle area.
[End of Your Turn] If your opponent has an unsuspended Digimon, this Digimon attacks a player.
